findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed volunteers rinsing dishes and filling up buckets inside of the designated hand washing sink. The PIC was informed and will be educating all volunteers about proper sink usage. Ensure that hand washing sinks are not used for any purpose other than hand washing.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed the inside of the ice machine had an accumulation of debris. The PIC cleaned the ice machine to sight and touch during the inspection. Ensure that food contact surfaces are cleaned at a frequency necessary to avoid the accumulation of soil residue and other debris.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: Observed the facility did not have test strips available. The inspector provided the facility with chlorine test strips during the inspection. Ensure that test kits are always available to measure the concentration of sanitizing solutions.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14 Sanitizing Solutions, Testing Devices. A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM. 
The current manager had a Certified Food Protection Manager license that expired. At time of inspection, she has her food handler card. The manager said she will obtain a CFPM license before the next routine inspection.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment: Observed ice scoops to be stored in a bus tub with some dust in it.  Take care to keep the holder and scoops clean. 750-850 Cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils shall be handled in a way that protects them from contamination.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.citation_text:
750.120 - Cans of green beans were observed in a cabinet beneath the plumbing of the dish washing sinks. Cans were moved to the far right end of the cabinet away from the plumbing.

Foods shall be properly stored and protected at all times.
Do not store food, clean equipment, or single service items (plastic utensils, plates, bowls, etc.) under the plumbing of sinks.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
750.800b - Mold was observed inside the ice machine in multiple places.

Clean and sanitize inside the ice machine as needed to eliminate buildup of mold.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.citation_text: 750.690 - A) Trim at counter edge was pulling apart (above dish towel and utensils storage drawers at south wall). Repair or replace the counter trim. B) Contact paper was peeling in the bottom cabinet below the mixer counter. Remove the peeling contact paper. Clean inside the cabinet and re-seal the area. C) Frost buildup was observed inside both reach-in freezers. Defrost the freezers. D) Freezer used for deli roll storage was damaged on the inside bottom right corner. Repair the damaged area (i.e. silicone a piece of cleanable plastic to the area). Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment: 750.830g - Test strips could not be located during the inspection. A bottle of bleach was observed, and a container of quaternary sanitizer was also observed hooked up at the large 3 part sink in the storage room. Obtain and use test strips for all sanitizers used at the facility. A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizers that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.citation_text: 750.820 - Various utensils and equipment (mixing bowl, pitchers) were being used by a ladies group from the church for a private luncheon. However, the utensils and equipment belong to the church and may be used when serving at a public event. Ladies were observed simply washing with soapy water and not doing proper manual wash, rinse, and sanitize. Also one lady rinsed a knife and then ran fingers over blade before placing the knife in the drying rack. Educational handout on manual dish washing was provided along with some test strips to allow ladies to properly clean and sanitize the aforementioned items at the end of their luncheon today. Bleach solution for sanitizing must be at 50ppm in 3 part sink, and all items must air dry prior to being placed back in storage cabinets and drawers. Properly clean and sanitize all food contact surfaces that belong to the church.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750.800b - The following food contact surfaces were soiled: A) inside ice machine (mold); B) butter dish in white fridge; & C) tops of knife holders (sticky/dust). Clean and sanitize all food contact surface between uses/as needed to prevent cross contamination and eliminate buildup of debris. **Manual wash, rinse, and sanitize should be done inside the ice machine on an as needed basis to minimize buildup of mold**

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled: A) inside cabinets throughout kitchen, especially in the following 1. below sinks, 2. bowl storage, 3. spice storage, & 4. baking supplies; B) inside ovens/around door seals; C) holding wells of steam table; D) bottom inside reach-in freezer used for nut storage; & E) inside Kenmore 22 fridge/freezer unit. Clean non-food contact surfaces daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.citation_text: 750.880 - Plastic forks and knives were observed with food surfaces extended up out of storage cups by the toaster. Store plastic utensils with food surfaces down inside containers and handles extended up. Single service items shall be stored, handled, and dispensed in a manner that protects food contact surfaces from potential contamination.

findings.title: Hand washing sinks installed, located, accessible
findings.citation_text: 750.1120 - Basin designated as handwashing sink was being used to wash dishes. Proper use of handsink was discussed. Ladies asked if the designated handsink could be relocated to the sink by the coffee maker. The sink designated for handwashing can be moved to the other sink with the understanding that the handsink is for handwashing only. The coffee pot must be filled and emptied using another sink in the kitchen rather than the sink next to it if that sink is to be designated for handwahsing. Handsinks are to be accessible at all times and used only for handwahsing.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.citation_text: 750.1170 - Outer door in storage room had gaps along right side and at the bottom where light was visible. The door needs to be repaired (weather stripping replaced) so light is not visible. Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects. Maintain outer openings tight fitting and vermin proof, especially doors near and/or in the kitchen and storage area.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment: The pulled pork was not labeled with date of prep. Kicthen staff was able to fill-in any information gaps. Staff was notified that this activity was not allowed within their medium risk permit and should be keeping a temp log.
